question: How did Kasthamandap come to be, and how did it give Kathmandu its name?
angle: The wooden shelter a whole city is named after
hooks: A whole city carries the name of one wooden shelter. Which one?
Legend says one tree gave all its wood. What did the ground underneath it say?

outline.beat: A whole city, Kathmandu, carries the name of one wooden shelter
The story people tell: all its timber came from a single tree
In that story, the tree god came down to watch the Machindranath chariot festival
In April 2015 the earthquake brought it down, with ten blood donors inside
The turn: how old was it really? Digging under the rubble dated the site to the 7th century
Rebuilt, it opened again in April 2022
The shelter stands again in the square of the city that took its name

versions.name: Single-tree legend
versions.summary: Legend says all the timber came from one giant tree; the Nepali Times account ties it to the tree god Kalpa Brikshya, who once came to Kathmandu to watch the Machindranath chariot festival.

facts.claim: The name Kathmandu comes from Kasthamandap, a wooden pavilion.
facts.claim_local: काठमाडौंको नाम काष्ठमण्डप नामको काठको पाटीबाट आएको हो।

sources.title: Kathmandu
sources.quote: The Nepali name Kathmandu comes from Kasthamandap.

sources.title: President Bhandari inaugurates reconstructed Kashthamandap temple
sources.quote: the temple which is the source of the name 'Kathmandu'

facts.claim: Legend says all the timber used to build Kasthamandap came from a single tree.
facts.claim_local: किंवदन्तीअनुसार काष्ठमण्डप बनाउन प्रयोग भएको सबै काठ एउटै रुखबाट आएको थियो।

sources.title: Kathmandu
sources.quote: According to legends, all the timber used to build the pagoda was obtained from a single tree.

sources.title: Resurrecting Kasthamandap from the rubble
sources.quote: legend has it that it was constructed from the timber of single giant tree

facts.claim: Legend says the tree god Kalpa Brikshya once visited Kathmandu to watch the Machindranath chariot festival.
facts.claim_local: किंवदन्तीअनुसार रुखका देवता कल्पवृक्ष एक पटक मछिन्द्रनाथको रथयात्रा हेर्न काठमाडौं आएका थिए।

sources.title: Resurrecting Kasthamandap from the rubble
sources.quote: The tree god Kalpa Brikshya is supposed to have visited Kathmandu once to witness the Machindranath chariot festival

facts.claim: Archaeological tests, including a 2016 excavation by the Department of Archaeology and Durham University, date the site to the 7th century CE.
facts.claim_local: सन् २०१६ को उत्खननसहितका पुरातात्त्विक परीक्षणले यो स्थल इस्वीको सातौँ शताब्दीको भएको देखाउँछन्।

sources.title: Kasthamandap
sources.quote: indicate that the Kasthamandap was built in the 7th century CE

sources.title: Resurrecting Kasthamandap from the rubble
sources.quote: in 2016 by the Department of Archaeology and Durham University puts the origins of the site even further back to the 7th century CE

facts.claim: On 25 April 2015, Kasthamandap collapsed along with many other buildings in Kathmandu Durbar Square.
facts.claim_local: २५ अप्रिल २०१५ मा काष्ठमण्डप काठमाडौं दरबार क्षेत्रका अरू धेरै भवनसँगै ढल्यो।

sources.title: Kasthamandap
sources.quote: On 25 April 2015, Kasthamandap and many other buildings in the Kathmandu Durbar Square collapsed

facts.claim: When it collapsed, ten blood donors inside were killed.
facts.claim_local: यो ढल्दा भित्र रक्तदान गरिरहेका दस जनाको ज्यान गयो।

sources.title: Resurrecting Kasthamandap from the rubble
sources.quote: The structure collapsed before the blood donors could scramble out to safety, killing 10 of them.

facts.claim: President Bidhya Devi Bhandari inaugurated the rebuilt Kasthamandap in April 2022.
facts.claim_local: राष्ट्रपति विद्यादेवी भण्डारीले सन् २०२२ अप्रिलमा पुनर्निर्मित काष्ठमण्डपको उद्घाटन गर्नुभयो।

sources.title: President Bhandari inaugurates reconstructed Kashthamandap temple
sources.quote: President Bidhya Devi Bhandari today inaugurated the much-hyped Kashthamandap temple

facts.claim: Carbon dating of one wooden joint in a beam gave a 5th-century date, but archaeologists have found no evidence of a structure that old.
facts.claim_local: एउटा काठको जोर्नी (मेख) को कार्बन डेटिङले पाँचौँ शताब्दी देखायो, तर त्यति पुरानो संरचना भएको प्रमाण पुरातत्त्वविद्हरूले भेटेका छैनन्।

sources.title: Resurrecting Kasthamandap from the rubble
sources.quote: Recent carbon dating also proved that a mekh (wooden joint) used in a wooden beam is even older -- from the 5th century.

sources.title: Resurrecting Kasthamandap from the rubble
sources.quote: Archaeologists have not found any evidence that there was a structure here from that far back

positions: Archaeology dates the site to the 7th century CE.
One carbon-dated wooden joint points to the 5th century, but no structure that old has been found.

dont_say.claim: Kasthamandap was built from a single tree.
dont_say.why: That is the legend. Attribute it: 'legend says'.
Only one wooden joint was carbon-dated to the 5th century; the site itself is dated to the 7th century CE.

gaps: The Nepali Times names a 1143 CE manuscript as the earliest written mention; the manuscript itself was not opened.
Accounts differ on who led the rebuild (a citizen-led committee in 2020, Kathmandu Metropolitan City by 2022); not needed for this script.
notes: The 2015 collapse killed ten people; keep that beat respectful and do not show bodies.
